name: radio-group
summary: Renders mutually exclusive native radio choices in an accessible fieldset.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned form needs one selection from 2–12 mutually exclusive options.
agent.avoidWhen: Choices are dynamic, require rich content, custom transport, client-side state, or a command lifecycle.

invariants: Uses native fieldset/legend and same-name radio inputs; native required and disabled behavior is preserved.
Contains 2..=12 choices with unique nonblank values; each choice has a nonblank label and optional nonblank hint.
Optional selected must match an enabled choice. A required group is natively required by its radio controls.
An optional safe explicit id names the fieldset; otherwise name is used. Choice, hint, error, and description IDs are deterministic and reserved.
Layout is stacked or inline. Group disabled state is native fieldset disabled state.
Names and IDs are non-reserved safe tokens; all copy and values are control-safe plain text escaped as HTML.
The app owns form, submission, transport, routes, and domain validation. No hidden transport, JavaScript, commands, arbitrary attributes, or raw markup are emitted.
The fragment has exactly one [[attributes]], [[legend]], [[choices]], and [[description]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

Native command forms require a declared Str carrier. Only enabled ticket-bounded choices are editable; omission becomes an empty string and must be validated by the app. Browser required constraints do not replace server validation.
Fully disabled groups are host-bound to the declared selection. Native build, desktop/mobile browser, keyboard, no-JS, and rejected-draft proof lives in tests/browser/choice-native-proof.mjs.
